test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Somebody paid the workers 2000 rupees.

options.text: 2000 rupees has been paid to the workers.
The workers were being paid 2000 rupees.
2000 rupees is paid to the workers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Somebody paid the workers 2000 rupees."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the workers" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "paid" to "were paid" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the amount "2000 rupees" after the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The workers were paid 2000 rupees."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"2000 rupees has been paid to the workers." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The workers were being paid 2000 rupees." – Incorrect aspect (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"2000 rupees is paid to the workers." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
